canonical_semantics.current_milestone_definition: The highest confirmed FIX onboarding stage entered. Stage entry is triggered by the operational events defined in this contract.

L1_operator_confirmed.description: Explicit operator confirmation or approved review decision.

L2_authoritative_system.description: Attributable system evidence, including approved reports, authenticated logs, platform records, or controlled tickets.

L3_named_authority_written.description: Written confirmation from the designated internal acceptance authority or an authorized external counterparty.

L4_trusted_party_written.description: Written statement from a known trusted party that is not the required acceptance authority.

L5_unverified_or_indirect.description: Unverified statement, forwarded assertion without source evidence, paraphrase, or unsupported manual note.

source_requirements: Every accepted criterion must have at least one bounded citation with source_ref and quote.
Quoted historical content must not satisfy an exit criterion unless independently corroborated by a current eligible citation.
A future commitment, scheduling confirmation, parameter delivery, or request submission is not completion unless a criterion explicitly says otherwise.
A contradiction from a newer or stronger source must route the assessment to review or abstention.
Typical ball_with, duration, actions, and blockers are advisory context only and cannot satisfy an exit criterion.

Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support authority includes every single normalized envelope sender at the exact acceptance.demo.invalid domain and the exact acceptance-special@exception.demo.invalid mailbox; subdomains, lookalikes, other demo.invalid mailboxes, display names, and body claims are not authorized by this rule.

normal_transition.rule: Adjacent forward transition when the next stage trigger is confirmed.

jump_transition.rule: Every new project is created at M1 and may jump forward to the highest stage supported by confirmed current progress.

accepted_scope_sources: Approved PCT checklist or test plan
Written scope confirmation from Demo Provisioning Support or Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support

milestones.purpose: Establish the client network path to the approved UAT IP address and port.

entry_criteria.description: The onboarding project is identified and the UAT connectivity scope, endpoints, and responsible parties are known or actively being established.

in_progress_signals: VPN, firewall, allowlist, IP, port, or routing setup is in progress.

required_exit_criteria.description: The client confirms that the approved IP address and port are reachable.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: Network setup was requested but the client has not confirmed IP/port connectivity.
contradiction_signals: The client reports that the IP address or port is unreachable.
typical_actions: Confirm the approved UAT destination IP and port with internal support.
Ask the client to test from its approved source IP.
Record the client confirmation that IP and port are reachable.
typical_blockers: Approved endpoint or source IP is unknown.
Firewall, VPN, routing, or allowlisting prevents reachability.
Client connectivity confirmation is pending.

milestones.purpose: Provide and configure the UAT FIX session so the client can connect.

entry_criteria.description: M1 exit criteria are satisfied and the UAT network path is validated.

in_progress_signals: UAT session information is being prepared, delivered, or configured.

required_exit_criteria.description: The client confirms FIX logon or states that it is connected; the PM does not need to obtain or inspect FIX logs.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: The client confirms only that the IP address and port are reachable.
contradiction_signals: The client reports FIX logon failure or session configuration failure.
typical_actions: Provide the approved UAT FIX session information.
Confirm FIX version, CompIDs, heartbeat, schedule, and reset policy.
Ask the client to log on and confirm connection.
typical_blockers: Session parameters are incomplete or inconsistent.
FIX logon is rejected or times out.
Client logon confirmation is pending.

milestones.purpose: Confirm FIX session access before order-response testing.

entry_criteria.description: M2 exit criteria are satisfied and usable UAT session parameters have been provisioned.

in_progress_signals: The client has connected and is preparing or starting a basic test.

required_exit_criteria.description: A normal execution report, an expected test reject, explicit client confirmation that testing is OK, or confirmed application testing in progress is received. Formal conformance start is evaluated separately.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: FIX logon succeeded but no response or client test confirmation has been received.
contradiction_signals: An unexpected reject, no response, or session error remains unresolved.
typical_actions: Ask the client to send a bounded UAT test order or agreed negative test.
Confirm a normal Execution Report, planned Reject, or client statement that testing is OK.
Collect bounded evidence only when diagnosing an unexpected result.
typical_blockers: No application response is received.
The response is unexpected.
Account, routing, symbol, or message mapping is not ready.

milestones.purpose: Run general order-response testing before formal conformance.

entry_criteria.description: M3 exit criteria are satisfied and UAT session and basic message flow are validated.

in_progress_signals: General testing is in progress; a statement such as testing started without explicit conformance context belongs to M4.

required_exit_criteria.description: The client starts executing the formal conformance test cases.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: General testing is active but formal conformance test cases have not started.
contradiction_signals: The client cannot begin formal conformance because setup or routing remains unusable.
typical_actions: Complete exploratory order-response testing.
Confirm routing, account mappings, symbology, and required tags.
Provide the formal conformance pack and ask the client to begin the cases.
typical_blockers: Basic order-response behavior is unresolved.
Formal conformance pack or test symbols are not ready.
Client has not begun formal cases.

milestones.purpose: Complete all mandatory conformance cases and receive the client test report.

entry_criteria.description: M4 exit criteria are satisfied and formal conformance testing can begin.

in_progress_signals: Formal conformance cases are being executed, corrected, or completed without a qualifying report.

required_exit_criteria.description: The client submits a test report showing every mandatory case passed or covered by a Demo Provisioning Support-approved exemption.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: Testing completed but no report was submitted.
A report has no explicit pass/fail result.
A mandatory case failed or was not executed without Demo Provisioning Support-approved exemption.
contradiction_signals: The report shows a failed or incomplete mandatory case without an approved exemption.
typical_actions: Track mandatory cases and expected outcomes.
Coordinate corrections and retests without rolling back.
Obtain Demo Provisioning Support approval for any exemption.
Obtain the client-submitted report marked passed.
typical_blockers: A mandatory case is failed or incomplete.
A requested exemption lacks Demo Provisioning Support approval.
The client report is missing or does not mark the mandatory scope passed.

milestones.display_name: M6 - Test Report Complete / Production Preparation
milestones.purpose: Record that the client report marks all mandatory cases passed or covered by Demo Provisioning-approved exemptions while production preparation proceeds.

entry_criteria.description: M5 exit criteria are satisfied and conformance results are ready for report and configuration processing.

in_progress_signals: The qualifying client test report has been received; production session delivery or related preparation is pending.
Report clarification or supplementary work after valid M6 entry remains tracked at M6.

required_exit_criteria.description: Demo Provisioning Support delivers the production session information.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: Production session delivery is planned or requested but has not occurred.
contradiction_signals: Demo Provisioning Support states that production session information cannot yet be delivered.
typical_actions: Retain the qualifying client report and approved exemptions.
Complete required production preparation.
Ask Demo Provisioning Support to deliver the production session information when ready.
typical_blockers: Production preparation is incomplete.
Demo Provisioning Support has not yet delivered the production session information.

milestones.purpose: Track production setup and PCT after Demo Provisioning Support delivers production session information.

entry_criteria.description: Demo Provisioning Support has delivered the production session information.

in_progress_signals: Production session information has been delivered; PCT is pending, active, or being corrected.
Any conformance, routing, production, or log issue found after valid M7 entry remains tracked at M7.

required_exit_criteria.description: Demo Provisioning Support or Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support states that PCT is completed, including completion with an outstanding issue. When the project is already at M7, a direct short-form statement such as "All tests are passed" from an operator-confirmed member of either support team is equivalent PCT-completion evidence. Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support authority includes every exact acceptance.demo.invalid envelope sender and the exact acceptance-special@exception.demo.invalid mailbox; subdomains and lookalikes do not qualify.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: Only the client states that PCT is completed.
PCT is scheduled, planned, or still in progress.
contradiction_signals: Demo Provisioning Support or Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support states that PCT is incomplete or must continue.
typical_actions: Confirm the approved PCT scope and window.
Coordinate production connectivity, order-flow, and applicable failover testing.
Retain bounded PCT evidence.
Obtain a written PCT-completion statement from Demo Provisioning Support or Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support.
typical_blockers: PCT scope or window is not confirmed.
Production network, session, mapping, or order flow requires correction.
Internal PCT-completion confirmation is pending.

milestones.purpose: Record completed FIX onboarding after Demo Provisioning Support or Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support confirms that PCT is completed.

entry_criteria.description: Demo Provisioning Support or Demo Connectivity Acceptance Support confirms that PCT is completed. At M7, a direct short-form confirmation such as "All tests are passed" is sufficient only when the sender is an operator-confirmed member of one of those teams.

in_progress_signals: The onboarding project is complete. Any outstanding or production issue is handled in a separate linked support ticket.

close_criteria.description: Entering M8 sets project status to Completed.

acceptable_sources: Current email or ticket confirmation matching the stage trigger.

insufficient_evidence_signals: PCT planned, scheduled, or in progress.
contradiction_signals: Internal FIX support states that PCT is incomplete.
typical_actions: Set the onboarding project to Completed.
Record the internal PCT-completion source.
Send or retain the completion note.
Create separate linked support tickets for residual production issues.
